description: Bond price, yield and duration — Offline bond math that matches spreadsheet PRICE / YIELD / DURATION / MDURATION. Required: coupon= (annual %) plus price= (clean, per 100) to solve yield OR ytm= (%) to solve price; and maturity=YYYY-MM-DD (optional settlement=, default today) or years=. Optional: freq= 1|2|4|12 (default 2), basis= 30/360 (default) | act/act | act/360 | act/365 | 30e/360, redemption= (default 100), face= (default 1000), call_date= + call_price= for yield-to-call/worst. Returns clean/dirty price, accrued interest, YTM, current yield, Macaulay and modified duration, convexity, DV01, +/-100bp price estimates, coupon dates and the cash-flow schedule. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: finance_bond
